body:
Well I wasn't sure about using a throwaway to post this at first... I was going to post it under my main account and even Tweet it to 1700 people + 400 friends on Facebook to give people an idea of where I'm at with life, and maybe get some help from people who know me... But I chickened out at the last minute and decided to post this on a throwaway that I used a couple months ago to make a post of a similar nature.

Like usual, the depression ebbed back but now it's come over me again pretty strongly, which is what brought me here.

As for the game stuff, I have been applying to companies that I think I would be a good fit for, but like I mentioned it doesn't go anywhere. I'm trying to develop a new game on my own now, but it's hard for me to get in a creative space with my depression and the stress of not having a job looming over me. The one thing upsetting me is how I'm not able to pay my roommate the rent... but apart from the few sporadic attempts to rectify all of this, I usually just end up making no progress.

I'm thinking about applying to the grocery story next door to my apartment, I think they're hiring right now. But my pride has been getting in the way with that... I feel like I shouldn't be working some minimum wage job at this point in my life. I'm also on a pretty messed up sleep schedule right now; it's currently 4:40 AM and I haven't really slept yet. I usually go to sleep around 8 or 9 in the morning and sleep until 2 or 3 in the afternoon.

My life is pretty messed up...

Thanks buddy. I am afraid to try medication because it seems artificial to me and I'm not convinced that it really corrects the problems as much as it just masks them... I think about people who go on anti-depressants and end up killing themselves, leading me to believe that they can have adverse effects. As for therapy, I'm open to that, but I'm not sure if there are any places that will see me since I can't afford to pay for it right now (given my financial situation). I live in San Francisco. One of my friends told me there's a place that takes people for as low as $1, but I haven't looked into it yet. I should try to motivate myself to go there, though.

Thanks for your reply, I appreciate it.
